categories.main_business_segments: Yinbang Clad Material Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the aluminum rolling processing industry, focusing on aluminum heat transfer materials, multi-metal composite materials, aluminum-steel composite materials, and aluminum alloy composite protective materials. The company serves sectors including automotive, air separation, power station air cooling, engineering machinery, power equipment, household appliances, consumer electronics, and energy storage. It has two main business divisions: metal composite materials and equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as brazing, lamination, rolling, heat treatment, and surface treatment to produce aluminum-based composite materials. It has proprietary core technologies in laminated composite materials, including multi-metal metallurgical bonding. The production employs large coil, wide-width, high-speed rolling lines with high automation and precision, supported by state-of-the-art testing and R&D facilities including spectrometry, mechanical testing, metallography, and electron microscopy.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global automotive system suppliers such as Valeo, DENSO, MAHLE, Modine, ONEGENE, and Hanon Systems, as well as major Chinese automotive manufacturers like BYD, Volkswagen, SAIC, Geely, and CATL. Over 70% of aluminum-based products are applied in the automotive industry, especially in new energy vehicles. Other markets served include home appliances, power equipment, consumer electronics, and energy storage sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in North China, South China, and East China regions. It also has a substantial export business, accounting for about 20% of revenue, serving international markets. Subsidiaries and operations extend to Japan and other locations, supporting global market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yinbang operates mainly in the midstream segment of the aluminum supply chain, focusing on processing and manufacturing aluminum composite materials from aluminum ingots. It procures raw aluminum upstream and supplies processed aluminum products downstream to automotive and other industrial customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes independent innovation and green low-carbon development, focusing on high-end aluminum heat transfer materials and customized high-performance products. R&D priorities include developing high-strength, lightweight multi-layer aluminum composites, aluminum-steel composites, titanium-aluminum composites for 3C industries, and materials for new energy vehicle battery thermal management. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 80 invention patents and multiple provincial key laboratories and innovation platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of metal composite materials and equipment manufacturing products. Pricing follows an 'aluminum ingot price plus processing fee' model, with aluminum prices referenced from domestic and international metal exchanges. Sales are conducted mainly via direct contracts with customers, both domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yinbang is one of the leading enterprises in China's aluminum rolling processing industry, recognized for its strong R&D capabilities, advanced manufacturing, and quality control. It holds a dominant market share in aluminum-steel composite materials for power station air cooling, breaking foreign monopolies. The company is positioned as a top-tier supplier to global automotive system manufacturers and is acknowledged as a provincial champion and internationally recognized brand in Jiangsu Province.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.35 billion, a 20.1% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 57.7 million, a slight decline of 10.5%. Total assets grew nearly 30% to RMB 5.84 billion. The company maintains steady growth with significant investments in new production capacity, including a RMB 1.37 billion investment in a new energy vehicle aluminum heat transfer materials project.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yinbang offers high-quality, highly customized aluminum composite materials with advanced metallurgical bonding technologies, catering to diverse and evolving customer needs. Its products provide superior strength, corrosion resistance, and thermal management performance, especially for new energy vehicles. The company emphasizes green, low-carbon production and innovation-driven development, positioning itself as a reliable partner for global automotive and industrial customers seeking lightweight, efficient material solutions.
